about: v0.6 Kathā story lines (OWNER: v0.6 WP-B): the new English lines inside { "if": "style.katha", "then": [...] } blocks of chapters 3–4 that no file 1–9 held at v0.5.1, and new Kathā-only speaker titles ("label": true). Rule: sa-verify collectStoryStrings; notes/v06-ownership.md. Same format and rules as files 1–9 (notes/sambhashana.md).

entries.en: Rama, these rakshasas have done us no harm. Must you fight them?
entries.sa: आर्यपुत्र, एते राक्षसाः अस्मान् न पीडितवन्तः। किं भवान् तैः सह युद्धं करिष्यति?

entries.en: I have given my word to the sages, Sita. I would sooner give up my life.
entries.sa: सीते, अहम् ऋषिभ्यः वचनं दत्तवान्। अहं प्राणान् त्यजेयम्, न तु वचनम्।

entries.en: As Ravana carried her off through the sky, Sita had called out to the trees.
entries.sa: रावणः सीताम् आकाशेन हृतवान्। तदा सीता वृक्षान् आहूतवती।

entries.en: Now Rama goes from tree to tree and asks each one.
entries.sa: अधुना रामः वृक्षात् वृक्षं गच्छति, सर्वान् पृच्छति च।

entries.en: The trees cannot answer. The Godavari is silent too: she fears Ravana.
entries.sa: वृक्षाः उत्तरं दातुं न शक्नुवन्ति। गोदावरी अपि तूष्णीं तिष्ठति, सा रावणात् बिभेति।

entries.en: Nearby, a herd of deer is resting. They look at Rama again and again.
entries.sa: तत्र मृगाः उपविशन्ति। ते पुनः पुनः रामं पश्यन्ति।

entries.en: Where is Sita? Tell me!
entries.sa: सीता कुत्र अस्ति? मां वदत!

entries.en: The deer rise at once. They face south, toward the sky where Sita was taken, and run to the river, looking back at Rama.
entries.sa: मृगाः सहसा उत्तिष्ठन्ति। ते दक्षिणां दिशम् आकाशं च पश्यन्ति। ते नदीं प्रति धावन्ति, पुनः पुनः रामं पश्यन्ति।

entries.en: Brother, the deer are showing us the way. South, across the river!
entries.sa: भ्रातः, मृगाः अस्मभ्यं मार्गं सूचयन्ति। नदीं तीर्त्वा दक्षिणां दिशं गच्छाम!

entries.en: Petals fall from a tree beside the hut. It saw everything.
entries.sa: आश्रमे एकस्मात् वृक्षात् पुष्पाणि पतन्ति। सः वृक्षः सर्वं दृष्टवान्।

entries.en: Sita asked the trees and the river to tell Rama. The river was afraid. But the trees remember her words.
entries.sa: सीता वृक्षान् नदीं च उक्तवती, रामाय कथयत इति। नदी भीता आसीत्। परन्तु वृक्षाः तस्याः वचनं स्मरन्ति।

entries.en: The tree is quiet now. A few petals still fall.
entries.sa: इदानीं वृक्षः शान्तः। अल्पानि पुष्पाणि पतन्ति।

entries.en: Lakshmana, this bird gave his life for us.
entries.sa: लक्ष्मण, अयं पक्षी अस्माकं कृते प्राणान् त्यक्तवान्।

entries.en: Sugriva welcomes the princes warmly and offers Rama his hand.
entries.sa: सुग्रीवः रामस्य लक्ष्मणस्य च स्वागतं करोति। सः रामाय हस्तं ददाति।

entries.en: Rama clasps his hand. Then Hanuman brings fire, and it burns between them.
entries.sa: रामः तस्य हस्तं गृह्णाति। ततः हनुमान् अग्निम् आनयति। सः अग्निः तयोः मध्ये ज्वलति।

entries.en: But Vali is mighty. Can anyone defeat him?
entries.sa: परन्तु वाली महाबलः। कः तं जेतुं शक्नोति?

entries.en: Seven great sala trees stand in a row. Rama takes up his bow and a single arrow.
entries.sa: तत्र सप्त सालाः क्रमेण तिष्ठन्ति। रामः धनुः एकं बाणं च गृह्णाति।

entries.en: In a moment the arrow flies back to Rama. Sugriva stares, amazed.
entries.sa: क्षणेन सः बाणः पुनः रामं प्रति आगच्छति। सुग्रीवः आश्चर्येण पश्यति।

entries.en: Vali fell to Rama's arrow. Before he died, he gave his son Angada this advice.
entries.sa: रामस्य बाणेन वाली पतितः। मृत्योः पूर्वं सः पुत्रम् अङ्गदम् एवम् उक्तवान्।

entries.en: The rains came. Rama waited on a nearby hill, thinking of Sita.
entries.sa: वर्षाः आगताः। रामः पर्वते वसति, सीतां स्मरति च।

entries.en: The rains passed, and the city celebrated its king.
entries.sa: वर्षाः गताः। नगरे जनाः राज्ञः उत्सवं कुर्वन्ति।

entries.en: Hanuman rises. The vanaras praise him, and with every word of praise he grows.
entries.sa: हनुमान् उत्तिष्ठति। वानराः तं प्रशंसन्ति, सः च वर्धते।

entries.en: He grows as vast as a mountain, and roars with joy.
entries.sa: सः पर्वतः इव महान् भवति, हर्षेण गर्जति च।

entries.en: Hanuman sits apart, silent, looking out over the sea.
entries.sa: हनुमान् दूरे तूष्णीं तिष्ठति, समुद्रं पश्यति।
